title: Not All Needles Are Found: How Fact Distribution and Don't Make It Up Prompts Shape Literal Extraction, Logical Inference, and Hallucination Risks in Long-Context LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on literal extraction and logical inference tasks by systematically sweeping the relative depth (position) of injected facts from 10% to 100% within a long narrative context, and by testing various probabilistic distributions (e.g., Normal, Exponential, Uniform) of fact placement to identify effects like 'lost-in-the-middle'.
